data.name: Aneeka
data.gender_notes: Aneeka is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Aneeka is derived from the Arabic and Urdu word ‘aneka’ which means ‘near’ or ‘close’. It is a beautiful name for a daughter, conveying a sense of closeness and love. The name Aneeka carries the meaning “Near, Close” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aneeka usually hope their child will grow to embody near, close and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the bond between a parent and child, and the love and care that is always present.
data.etymology: Aneeka belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Near, Close.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aneeka total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aneeka holds a deep cultural significance especially in the South Asian communities where it is commonly used. It is often given to a daughter to symbolize the bond of love and closeness between parents and their child. This name also reflects the importance of relationships and the value of staying close in family and community.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Aneeka can be seen as a reminder of the divine presence and nearness of God in our lives. Just as we seek closeness and love from our parents and loved ones, may we also seek and strive for closeness and obedience to God. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, “Allah is closer to you than is your own self.” (Bukhari and Muslim). Therefore, the name Aneeka can also serve as a reminder of the nearness of God and the importance of keeping a strong and constant spiritual connection with Him.
